definitions.explanation: The period of dim light between day and night, particularly the time just after sunset when the sky still holds some light. A literary and formal term.

examples.english: Accidents are common during twilight hours.

examples.japanese: {薄暮|はくぼ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一番星|いちばんぼし}→一番星：08953_ichibanboshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いていた→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧。
examples.english: The first star was shining in the twilight sky.

notes:
FORMS:
{薄|はく} (thin, faint) + {暮|ぼ} (dusk, evening)

REGISTER:
{薄暮|はくぼ} is a literary/formal term. In everyday conversation, ⟦{夕暮|ゆうぐ}れ→夕暮れ：07682_yuugure⟧ or ⟦{日暮|ひぐ}れ→日暮れ：10086_higure⟧ are more common.

TRAFFIC SAFETY:
{薄暮|はくぼ}⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧ (twilight hours) is particularly dangerous for driving because visibility decreases but headlights are not yet fully effective.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{夕暮|ゆうぐ}れ→夕暮れ：07682_yuugure⟧: evening, dusk (common)
- ⟦{黄昏|たそがれ}→黄昏：05046_tasogare⟧: twilight (literary)
- ⟦{日暮|ひぐ}れ→日暮れ：10086_higure⟧: dusk, sunset
- ⟦{黎明|れいめい}→黎明：10199_reimei⟧: dawn (opposite time)
